e.body: 这是一个 **MSc 学位论文的可复现分析管道**（Zenodo 开放获取，MIT 许可，2026-08-20，DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22020127`），对应伦敦玛丽女王大学（Queen Mary University of London）2026 年论文《A Study of Claims Inflation in Malaysian Motor Insurance: An Inflation-Adjusted Chain Ladder Approach》。包内 5 个文件、代码主体为单个 63KB Python 管道（另含 README、requirements、LICENSE、CHANGELOG，工程规范完整）：从**市场整体汇总理赔数据**估计马来西亚**私家车 Own Damage（车损）与 Third Party Property Damage（三者财损）**的**逐日历季度理赔通胀**，方法用对数线性与分段回归（piecewise regression），并做验证。对 RIAA：这条补上的是一个**此前完全空白的形态——「学位论文级可复现包」**：它不只是方法，而是**一线可跑的完整代码 + 数据来源说明 + 项目结构规范**，对准备做毕业论文的学生价值非常直接（可对照自己的代码组织、requirements 管理、CHANGELOG 实践）。方法上它串起了本 wiki 的两条主线：**理赔通胀**（[[insurance-trend]]、[[insurance-nowcast]] 是对应的方法论条目）与**链梯法准备金**（[[chainladder-python]]、[[chainladder]]、[[dcl]]），而「通胀调整」正是把两者接起来的关键环节；可复现工程实践可对照 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 与 [[actuarial-python-lab]]；区域上马来西亚车险参见 [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]。适合作毕业论文选题、准备金与通胀方法论、以及代码工程规范参考。
e.body_en: This is an **MSc dissertation reproducibility package** (open access on Zenodo, MIT licensed, 2026-08-20, DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22020127`), accompanying the 2026 Queen Mary University of London dissertation "A Study of Claims Inflation in Malaysian Motor Insurance: An Inflation-Adjusted Chain Ladder Approach". The record has five files with the code as a single 63KB Python pipeline (plus README, requirements, LICENSE and CHANGELOG — complete engineering hygiene): it estimates **calendar-quarter claims inflation** for **Malaysian private car Own Damage and Third Party Property Damage** from market-wide aggregated claims data, using log-linear and piecewise regression, and includes validation. For RIAA: this fills a **previously empty form — the dissertation-grade reproducibility package**. It is not just a method but **a complete runnable codebase with documented data provenance and project structure**, directly useful to students preparing a dissertation (compare your own code organisation, requirements management and CHANGELOG practice). Methodologically it connects two of this wiki’s threads: **claims inflation** (with [[insurance-trend]] and [[insurance-nowcast]] as the corresponding methodology entries) and **chain-ladder reserving** ([[chainladder-python]], [[chainladder]], [[dcl]]) — inflation adjustment being the link between them; for reproducible engineering practice compare [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[actuarial-python-lab]]; for the regional context of Malaysian motor insurance see [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]. Suits dissertation topic selection, reserving and inflation methodology, and code-engineering standards.
e.body_hk: 這是一個 **MSc 學位論文的可復現分析管道**（Zenodo 開放獲取，MIT 許可，2026-08-20，DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22020127`），對應倫敦瑪麗女王大學（Queen Mary University of London）2026 年論文《A Study of Claims Inflation in Malaysian Motor Insurance: An Inflation-Adjusted Chain Ladder Approach》。包內 5 個檔案、代碼主體為單個 63KB Python 管道（另含 README、requirements、LICENSE、CHANGELOG）：從**市場整體匯總理賠數據**估計馬來西亞**私家車 Own Damage 與 Third Party Property Damage** 的**逐日曆季度理賠通脹**，方法用對數線性與分段回歸。對 RIAA：這補上的是一個**此前完全空白的形態——「學位論文級可復現包」**：不只是方法，而是**一線可跑的完整代碼 + 數據來源說明 + 專案結構規範**，對準備做畢業論文的學生價值直接。方法上串起兩條主線：**理賠通脹**（[[insurance-trend]]、[[insurance-nowcast]]）與**鏈梯法準備金**（[[chainladder-python]]、[[chainladder]]、[[dcl]]）；可復現工程實踐可對照 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[actuarial-python-lab]]；區域上馬來西亞車險參見 [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]。適合作畢業論文選題、準備金與通脹方法論、以及代碼工程規範參考。
